g.title: j2520950851
g.text: Hey Roathe? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]

g.title: j1323189664
g.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.

g.title: j3803031337
g.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you.

g.title: j2588321810
g.text: Do go on. This sounds like it is going to be quite good.

g.title: j3682452848
g.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.

g.title: j1163803569
g.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.

g.title: j486309173
g.text: Wait. By the Void, are you trying to tip-toe around the news that you have another partner?

g.title: j2485219467
g.text: How much of a fool do you think I am? I already know, Drifter dear!

g.title: j1442403859
g.text: I take it you don't mind, then?

g.title: j3386318103
g.text: If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter. I am Orokin. Of course I do not mind.

g.title: j2687014579
g.text: If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter.

g.title: j3527982302
g.text: Think what you will about my society and our penchant for enjoying the company of others in a way you may see as dismissive and belittling, we also understood what it was like to love.

g.title: j870500453
g.text: I knew the moment it happened. I have my methods. And no, I do not mind in the slightest. I am Orokin.

g.title: j2187937971
g.text: No one understood love like the Orokin. And we knew that one could have room in the heart for more than one.

g.title: j4075955240
g.text: I am merely disappointed that the zealots are likely too close-minded to join in the fun.

g.title: j3985975724
g.text: Pah. On second thought, that is likely for the best. Can you imagine the nonsense that would cause?

g.title: j734923305
g.text: Well, regardless. If they make you happy, then enjoy them. But know that when you are with me?

g.title: j2791546436
g.text: You are mine and mine alone.
